literature_notes: Both ledger clips (L1, L2) describe the same construct: pLVX-IRES-puro-NECTIN1-2×HA-3×FLAG, synthesized by a commercial vendor (RuiBiotech). Neither clip states the position of the 2×HA-3×FLAG tags within the NECTIN1 coding sequence. The rules explicitly disqualify 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue.' The naming convention 'NECTIN1-2×HA-3×FLAG' (gene name followed by tag names) is consistent with C-terminal placement, which for NECTIN1 (a type I single-pass transmembrane protein with extracellular residues 31–355, TM 356–376, intracellular 377–517) would be intracellular and therefore not a surface tag site. Even if one attempted a topology_derived reading (the only extracellular terminus is the mature N-terminus after signal peptide cleavage at residue 30), the clips do not confirm N-terminal placement and the naming convention argues against it. No qualifying insertion is grounded in the ledger; zero sites is the correct answer.
